title: Lunch break? Pick up the chat.
lead: Their AI clone remembers what you’ve talked about and what to call you. So every chat picks up right where you left off.

chat.label: Chat
chat.title: After the call, keep it going in chat.
chat.body: Calls are transcribed into your chat. They reply right away, in their own way of talking.

stories.label: Stories
stories.title: Turn a reply into a picture and a voice.
stories.body: Make an image and a voice clip from one of their replies, then post both as a Story. Send hearts and replies to Stories others made.

memory.label: Our bond & memories
memory.title: Your nickname. Their tone. Your call.
memory.body: Choose what they call you and pick a relationship mode. See what they remember, lock the moments that matter, and edit or delete the rest.

stageAlt: Illustrations of chat, Stories and the bond & memories screen.
